items.title: 腾讯开源 Hy4：770B 总参数、每 token 激活 49B
items.summary: 腾讯 Hy 团队开放了新一代 MoE 旗舰模型 Hy4 的权重，同时提供 Hy4-FP8 和预训练 base 模型，支持文本、图像和视频理解，上下文长度 1M。模型卡称它在 579 个真实金融任务上排在开放权重模型第一，但也承认与顶级闭源模型仍有明显差距。许可是 Tencent Hy License，商用前要先读条款；需要自部署长上下文大模型的团队多了一个开放权重选项。

evidence.quote: Hy4 is a new-generation Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) flagship model developed by the Tencent Hy Team, supporting text, image, and video understanding. The language backbone comprises 770B total parameters, of which 49B are activated per token.
Context Length 1M (1,048,576 tokens)
Across 579 real-world financial tasks, Hy4 ranks first among open-weight models
a notable gap remains between it and top proprietary models
We open-source Hy4 , Hy4-FP8 , and the pre-trained Hy4 base model weights on Hugging Face
Hy4 is released under the Tencent Hy License

items.title: Apple 发布 Depth Pro 2：一个网络同时做图片和视频的度量深度
items.summary: Apple 机器学习研究团队发布 Depth Pro 2，从普通相机拍摄的照片、视频或实时画面逐像素估计以米为单位的深度，按输入的完整分辨率输出。作者指出以往方法要在时间一致性和边缘锐利度之间取舍，Depth Pro 2 用单个网络同时做到度量准确、锐利和时间一致，并开放代码和从 24M 到 872M 参数的多个尺寸权重。权重采用 Apple Machine Learning Research Model license，仅限非商业研究；需要视频深度的研究项目可以按速度和质量在几个尺寸里选。

evidence.quote: Depth Pro 2 estimates the depth of every pixel, in meters, from images taken with an ordinary camera.
multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness
Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions.
We release code and weights here
S apple/DepthPro2-S 24M 97 MB B apple/DepthPro2-B 97M 386 MB L apple/DepthPro2-L 334M 1.3 GB H+ apple/DepthPro2-H 872M 3.5 GB
The weights are released under the Apple Machine Learning Research Model license , for research use only: non-commercial scientific research and academic development.

items.title: pi-H3：MiniMax H3 音视频生成只要 2 到 4 步
items.summary: 斯坦福等作者在 Hugging Face 发布 pi-H3，为 MiniMax H3 提供 2 步和 4 步适配器，结合 pi-Flow v2 少步蒸馏和 DWD（Decoding Without a Decoder），在最后一步直接预测视频帧，跳过 VAE 解码器。作者称这是生成带同步音频的 MiniMax H3 视频最快的方式；适配器支持文本、首帧和尾帧条件，另有 ComfyUI 用的 INT8 版本，使用受 MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement 约束。

evidence.quote: 2-step and 4-step adapters of MiniMax H3 , the fastest way to generate MiniMax H3 videos with synchronized audio. pi-H3 combines pi-Flow v2 few-step distillation with DWD (Decoding Without a Decoder), which predicts the video frames directly at the last step, so the video skips the VAE decoder.
All adapters support text, first-frame, and last-frame conditioning. We recommend the DWD adapters. The INT8 ConvRot versions are for ComfyUI only.
The pi-H3 adapters are Model Derivatives of MiniMax H3 and are distributed under the MiniMax H3 Community License Agreement
1 Stanford University

items.title: InclusionMed：按医疗角色和能力评测，前沿模型总分 17.5 到 49.1
items.summary: InclusionMed 是一个开放的医疗 AI 评测项目，按三种医疗角色和三种 AI 能力组织基准；首版从 388 个候选里筛出四个公开基准，加上私有诊断推理基准 InclusionMed-DxFiles，覆盖九个格子中的三个。前沿 LLM 总分在 17.5 到 49.1（满分 100）之间，排名随角色和能力变化，排名前十的模型在患者沟通上的得分都高于临床决策。做医疗应用的开发者应按具体场景选模型，分数相近的模型推理成本也可能差很多。

evidence.quote: For the first release, we selected four public benchmarks from 388 candidates through structured audits and independent reproduction.
with overall scores ranging from 17.5 to 49.1 out of 100

items.title: VibePrevisBench：评测编码 Agent 在 Blender 里搭 4D 场景
items.summary: VibePrevisBench 让 Agent 根据需求在 Blender 中写出可执行的 4D 场景并渲染代理视频，共 242 个任务，输入包括脚本、照片、续写和参考视频；评分分为重跑代码、对照隐藏事实的 Scene Check 和由 VLM 判断的 Screen Check。作者分析了 11 个前沿编码 Agent，发现多模态理解（尤其是空间和镜头运动）拉开差距，Agent 会检查自己的渲染却改不掉错误。做创意工具类 Agent 时，逐项对照需求核验渲染结果是目前的短板。

evidence.quote: Its 242 tasks span four input kinds, including scripts, photos, continuations, and reference videos.
We analyze the evaluation results and trajectories of 11 frontier coding agents and identify three key observations.
Third, agents inspect their own renders but fail to correct their errors.

items.title: AscendGYM：评测 Agent 在昇腾 NPU 上优化 kernel
items.summary: AscendGYM 是面向 Ascend NPU 的 kernel 优化基准，首批 48 个 kernel 分三个难度，测试用例的数据类型和张量形状取自真实训练和推理任务；支持只评模型和评“模型加 harness”两种模式。论文还提出 Speedup-Token Score（STS），把加速幅度和 token 成本放在一起算。在昇腾上做训练或推理优化的团队，可以用它衡量编码 Agent 在预算内的实际优化能力。

evidence.quote: we introduce AscendGYM, a benchmark whose initial suite comprises 48 kernels across three difficulty levels. Each kernel is paired with test cases whose data types and tensor shapes are collected from real-world training and inference tasks.
we propose a new metric, the Speedup-Token Score (STS) , which quantifies performance gains relative to token cost

items.title: Transformers v5.24.0 加入 Inkling 2 Mini、Apertus 1.5 和 Dory
items.summary: Hugging Face Transformers v5.24.0 新增一批模型：Thinking Machines Lab 的 Inkling 2 Mini（第 6 到 17 层循环运行三次）、Swiss AI Initiative 的多模态模型 Apertus 1.5 及其音频分词器 WavTokenizer、NVIDIA 的循环语言模型 Dory，以及 HY4-VL 和 Meta FAIR 覆盖 1,600 多种语言的 Omnilingual ASR。Dory 可以在同一个 checkpoint 上于推理时调整循环次数、用速度换质量；升级后即可直接用 Transformers 加载这些模型。

evidence.quote: Apertus 1.5 is a multimodal model from the Swiss AI Initiative that accepts text, images and audio and generates text.
Dory is a looped (latent-recurrent) language model from NVIDIA.
The loop count can be changed at inference time on the same checkpoint to trade speed against quality.
HY4-VL (Hunyuan V4 Vision-Language) combines the HYV4 mixture-of-experts text backbone with a vision encoder for image-text and video-text generation.
Omnilingual ASR is a suite of multilingual speech-recognition models from Meta FAIR that covers more than 1,600 languages.
The 40-token-per-second variant is the audio tokenizer of Apertus 1.5.
